It takes twenty minutes to get to the train station by bike. They took many photos at the bus stop. Lily is interested in singing. We arrived at the museum at nine.
Owen and Lily had great fun there. Owen learned a lot about English. The train station is one of the best places in the city. What's more, you must submerge the noodles in boiling water.
Owen plays basketball with Lily every Saturday. The weather was windy that day. Lily's birthday is in February. Also, the magician amazed the unsuspecting crowd with simple tricks.
Life is full of small surprises. Owen hopes to visit Tokyo one day. Owen usually has bread for breakfast.
